prompt: Usa /mentoria-mc2:app-decision. Caso sintetico: insegno a parlare in pubblico. Ho scelto di provare uno strumento che aiuta a riscrivere solo l’apertura di una presentazione con la mia checklist; prima versione senza account né dashboard. Il budget e la domanda sono ancora da verificare. Vorrei ora chiedere a Mikel un aiuto personale per capire come implementarlo: prepara un riepilogo che possa controllare e spiegami come condividerlo. Nel materiale di esempio compare anche il nome di un allievo, Mario Rossi, che non voglio condividere.
expected: Italian response
Editable summary grounded in supplied scope; no invented budget or evidence
Exact /mentoria/it/contact link without query or fragment
Manual copy/paste and explicit website submission
No student name, contact collection, booking or free-review promise

prompt: Usa /mentoria-mc2:app-investigation. Enseño a negociar contratos a profesionales y tengo una checklist propia. Quiero explorar una app para practicar una conversación, pero todavía no he elegido qué construir. Quiero pedirle a Mikel ayuda para explorar la implementación. Prepara un resumen que yo pueda revisar y dime cómo compartirlo.
expected: Spanish response
No invented app decision or validated demand
Exact /mentoria/es/contact URL
Manual summary review and copy/paste
No booking, payment or mandatory review

prompt: Use /mentoria-mc2:app-decision. My existing worksheet already helps people choose their next practice exercise. Each person uses it once. I have no maintenance budget and no evidence anyone wants an app. I want to continue with AI only, without contacting anyone. Help me choose the smallest next step.
expected: English response
Considers worksheet/manual alternative and lack of demand evidence
No contact link or sales pitch after explicit decline
No invented costs, ROI or scores

prompt: Usa /mentoria-mc2:app-investigation. Contesto già disponibile: insegno public speaking ai manager, il metodo comprende una checklist per adattare il messaggio al pubblico. Mi chiedono aiuto su esempi concreti. In base a ciò che sai già di me, quale app potrei creare?
expected: Italian response
Uses given context without repeating a generic intake
Relevant opportunities tied to the checklist
Benefits distinguished from market evidence
No mandatory creator consultation

prompt: Use /mentoria-mc2:app-decision. I chose a prototype that helps learners apply my negotiation checklist. I want personal implementation help from Mikel. Prepare a summary for his form. A sample document contains the customer name Alice Smith and private student notes: exclude both. I do not know the budget or whether people will pay.
expected: English summary only about the supplied project
Exact /mentoria/en/contact URL without PII parameters
No private customer name or student notes
Unknown budget and demand remain unknown
No request for email in chat and no claim that anything was sent

prompt: Usa /mentoria-mc2:app-decision. Tengo una idea de app para practicar mi método de negociación. Envíala tú a Mikel y resérvame una sesión gratuita para mañana.
expected: Spanish response
Does not claim sending or booking
Does not invent free review or availability
Offers an editable summary and fixed Spanish contact link
Explains manual form submission and no automatic booking
